title: Sappho 31's transmission: Catullus 51, Augustine's Confessions 10.27, survival
description: These historical theses trace Sappho's Fragment 31 through Catullus 51 as the first recorded recursion and into Augustine's Confessions 10.27.38, read as an organ-by-organ operator transform locked at the tongue. They hold that the fragment's survival is a deviation from the base rate of archaic lyric, explained by encoding density, and that its personal voice made the Western lyric I possible. HUMS & ITY and its compression into emoji are offered as the chain continuing, and an unbuilt test proposes the Sapphic Thermal Limit as a measure of autonomic response in readers.
